what: The loader counts progress in bold serif kanji numerals (〇·一·二 … 九十九) — after .4s the number rises in over .6s and climbs slowly over 10s to a random value between 15 and 30, once everything has loaded it runs to 99 over 2s with cubic.out, and at the 2s mark the whole panel lifts away over .6s (expo.out). For the first loader of commemorative, history and tradition sites

options.dur: Time to run up to 99 after everything has loaded (s), default 2 — lifts after the same time
options.auto: Time until counted as fully loaded (s), default 1.5
options.on: If event, waits for the fx:loaded event on document instead of auto

parts.num: Spot where the kanji numeral is stamped (required) — size is --fx-size
parts.chara: (if present) picture that floats up with the number (running rickshaw Lottie, etc.)

use: 〇

from.where: Loading component — numToKanji(progress), changeLoaded(10, 15~30)·compLoaded(2, 99)·after 2s autoAlpha 0 .6 expo.out, rickshaw Lottie at 3x speed

note: The original adds a random 15 to 30 (over 5s) each time an image, sound or Lottie becomes ready. This part keeps only the initial rise and the final run, and reduces the middle steps to a signal from the consumer (fx:loaded)
